ARCHITECTURE:
PATTERN: 9 exercise types, all except Construct use local evaluation (pattern matching, keyword whitelists, structural rules — no LLM)

TYPES (in difficulty progression order):
1. Classify — pick 1 from 4 (recognition intro, max 2 per technique)
2. MultiSelect — pick 2+ correct from 4-5 (recognition+)
3. SpotTheFlaw — tap flawed word chips, F1 scoring prevents carpet-bombing
4. HighlightReplace — tap flaw + type the fix (two-step)
5. FillTemplate — pick phrase to complete sentence (make options same length/structure to prevent 'pick the shortest' gaming)
6. SlotFill — type into blank slots in a frame, keywords validated against whitelist
7. Transform — rewrite bad response, validated by: starts-with, contains emotion word, no banned phrases, length bounds
8. IfThen — write if-then script, 'then' clause validated for technique pattern
9. Construct — free-form, LLM evaluates (reserved for top difficulty only)

KILL LIST (no new content): wordBankBuilder, sequenceOrder, highlightWords

DIFFICULTY = remove scaffolding, not add text:
- Diff 1: Full template visible, one slot, broad accept set
- Diff 2: Partial template, two slots, narrower acceptance
- Diff 3: No template, only rule constraints, tight validation

WHY: Research confirms production > recognition for skill acquisition; constrained production (pattern matching) enables local eval without LLM.
